attributes.title: 2027 ACG's Esophagus School & ACG/FGS Annual Spring Symposium
attributes.series: ACG Esophagus School & ACG/FGS Annual Spring Symposium
attributes.venue: Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort
attributes.summary:
This Naples weekend combines two programs from the American College of Gastroenterology. The Esophagus School fills Friday, March 5, 2027, and ACG notes it should suit community-based gastroenterologists. The Spring Symposium, run with the Florida Gastroenterologic Society, follows in half-day sessions on Saturday and Sunday, March 6 and 7, so afternoons stay free.

The Esophagus School carries 7.25 AMA PRA Category 1 credits and the Symposium 9, each with matching ABIM MOC points. Fees are set separately for each part. For the Symposium, members pay $449 and non-member physicians $549 through February 11, and non-member NPs and PAs pay $349. The Esophagus School is cheaper, starting at $125 for members.

The group rate at the Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort is $389 a night plus tax and a $20 daily resort fee, bookable until February 11, 2027. Fees vary by membership level, so check the full table on the ACG page before registering.
